Ascension paths are paths of either [[Ennoblement]] or [[Ascension]] or both.<ref>https://evolution.faith/the-paths-of-ascension/</ref>

* [[Apotheosis]] both
* [[Faustery]] only [[Ascension]]
* [[Rehabilitation]] only [[Ennoblement]]
